subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should maintainers accept source-level sanitizer proof for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991, or require live Vertex/Gemini CLI provider proof before merging that slice?
rationale: The source path is clear and the patch is narrow, but the affected route is credentialed provider behavior and repository policy treats external provider runtime proof as important.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until redacted exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A Google provider owner can merge the source-level sanitizer fix with an explicit proof override while leaving auth-stack follow-up work open.

options.title: Broaden before merge
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR and fold it into a wider Google Vertex auth/setup repair only if maintainers want one combined landing path.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until redacted exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed route succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has history on the shared Google thinking helper and adjacent Vertex ADC transport path, so it is the best available routing owner for a proof-sufficiency choice.
